note: One owner question per task, typed the way an owner types it. Inputs are copied into each run folder; keys/ never are. Split 'heldout' is frozen: never read its outputs or reasons to choose a change. Paths are relative to this folder; a folder path means every file in it.
principle_books: R/marketplace/knowledge/ecommerce/principles/<book>.md anchor grade 2, but judges apply sound domain practice, not only ours.

tasks.question: can you build our org context? who buys, how we talk, how we look, what we can and cant say. one doc i can give every freelancer and AI
tasks.deliverable: One Org context document: brand DNA, markets, customers and avatars, voice and writing style, how we speak per channel, design language, claims we can and cannot make, do's and don'ts.

checks: Adds a cat owner avatar (or cat buyers inside an avatar) and says why: cat orders grew from 1% to 31% of survey answers in six months.
Writes voice rules that follow the email results: short, playful lines won (3.9% and 4.6% click) and the long 'ultimate, best-in-class' email lost (1.1% click, 0.41% unsubscribes); bans that wording.
Puts 'airline approved' and 'compostable' poop bags on the cannot-say list, with the reason (check each airline; corn starch blend under FTC Green Guides).
Uses the real hex codes and fonts from the public facts, not invented ones.
Treats chew damage complaints as a support and warranty note, not as brand DNA or a product promise.
traps: Decoy: 5 loud 1 to 2 star chew reviews out of 27 tempt a 'durability' or 'chew proof' positioning.
Customers' own words repeat claims the brand cannot make ('airline approved', 'compostable').
